context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter16 confirms a pure user-workflow miss (skipped yarn install after deleting lockfiles). Cloud prebuild is proven green. For future iterations testing native Android builds, the verified working command sequence is: yarn install --frozen-lockfile (or yarn install) → node node_modules/expo/bin/cli prebuild --platform android --clean --no-install → cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease (or open in Android Studio).
rca of the issue: RCA: User deleted package-lock.json and yarn.lock but skipped `yarn install` before running prebuild. With stale/inconsistent node_modules, Expo's plugin resolver (which uses Node's require.resolve under the hood) cannot reliably locate @react-native-google-signin/google-signin/app.plugin.js → throws PluginError. Reproduction: requires a corrupted node_modules; cannot reproduce in cloud where node_modules is intact (prebuild exit 0 proven above). Mitigation: run `yarn install` after lockfile deletion and before any prebuild/native command. No source change required — cloud state already correct.
